description: Verify a citation someone else produced — does the pinpoint exist in held text, and optionally does the quote appear. Pass the cite as written (e.g. 'Article 6(1) EU AI Act') plus optional quote=. Then read_unit for full text. regulation= disambiguates when the cite omits the act name; returns regulation_mismatch when the cite embeds YYYY/NNNN for a different act.

as_of.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD: answer with the wording in force on that date (default today). Amended provisions say which act gave them their wording
as_of.title: As Of

citation.description: Citation as written, e.g. Article 6(1) EU AI Act
citation.title: Citation

cite.description: Alias for citation when agents pass cite= instead of citation=
cite.title: Cite

quote.description: Optional sentence to check against held text
quote.title: Quote

regulation.description: Regulation id when the cite string alone is ambiguous
regulation.title: Regulation

name: verify_citation
title: Verify a citation
